div.div: 4 اغلى القِدْرَ , (S, MA, K,) and ↓ غلّاهَا , (K,) He made the cooking-pot to boil. (S, * MA, K. *) IDrd mentions, among some of the sayings of the people of former ages, ↓ أُنَّ مَآءً وَغَلِّهِ [Pour thou out water, and make it to boil]. (TA.) And one says, أَغْلَيْتُ الزَّيْتَ وَنَحْوَهُ [I made the olive-oil and the like to boil], inf. n. إِغْلَآءٌ. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
